title: Google News API Scraper – RSS, Real URLs, News Monitoring
description: Search Google News RSS by keyword, topic or publisher and get structured articles: headline (raw and with the " - Publisher" suffix stripped), publisher name and domain, date, feed rank, resolved publisher URL, related coverage of the same story, and optional full article text. Pay per article.
seoTitle: Publisher News Scraper, News Feed API, News Alerts API
seoDescription: A news aggregator API and media monitoring API: scrape Google News or any RSS feed to JSON/CSV. Topic news scraper with real time news api data, news headlines api fields, and a news dataset feed.
